question: India's first and the world's second 100% methanol-powered prototype truck was unveiled in______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first **100% methanol-powered prototype truck** was unveiled in **Bengaluru.**
 
• **Methanol **is a **clean-burning fuel **that emits lower levels of** greenhouse gases and pollutants** compared to diesel fuel, making it an attractive alternative for transportation.
 
• The truck was developed by **Eicher Motors and IIT Delhi,** and is part of the government's push towards using alternative fuels to reduce India's dependence on **imported oil** and improve** air quality.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **world's first methanol-powered truck** was developed by **Volvo in 2017** and has been in use in **Sweden.**
 
• The first **methanol-powered buses** were unveiled in **Bengaluru **by Union Minister of Road and Transport **Nitin Gadkari** in association with the Indian Oil Company (IOC), Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC), NITI Aayog, and Ashok Leyland.
